note: Alberta Parks campground at Rock Lake, 35 km west of Hwy 40 on a gravel road north-west of Hinton, run by West Fraser Mills and the Fox Creek Development Association. The 54-site Green Mountain Loop sits in forest south-east of the lake; smaller Moose Landing loops are on the north shore, with walk-in tent sites, equestrian camps with corrals, and a Willmore Wilderness staging area. Boat launch and fish cleaning at the Windy Bay day use. The pump water is not drinkable. Logging trucks use the access road, which can flood after heavy rain or snowmelt. --Claude
summary: Read the Alberta Parks page and West Fraser's page and map: C$20 confirmed, plus a C$10 operator reservation fee, a C$15 seniors rate and C$6 per horse; 79 unserviced sites; vault toilets, pump water not drinkable; season May 1 - Oct 31; reservable by phone (46 of 104 sites) with first-come for the rest. Lakeview doubtful: the evidence and the pin are at the Windy Bay day use; recommend not waterfront and moving the pin ~870 m to Green Mountain Loop.
flags: PIN (53.46810,-118.25210): on the Windy Bay Day-Use Area loop (boat launch, picnic shelter, fish cleaning on the campground map), not a camping loop. The page's directions point 53.464245,-118.240565 falls on Green Mountain Loop (54 sites, the main loop) in forest south-east of the lake. Recommend moving the pin to 53.46425,-118.24057 (~870 m south-east).

WATERFRONT (stored lakeview; recommend not waterfront - downgrade, unsure): the stored evidence ('loop runs ~50-70 m back from Rock Lake ... boat-launch spur to a small beach') describes the Windy Bay day-use loop at the pin, where there are no campsites. Green Mountain Loop, which holds most RV sites, is in dense conifer forest ~200-300 m from the lake's east end. The Moose Landing loops (Lower 7-12, Upper 13-20) are on the north shore by the boat launch per the map, but they are under continuous canopy on imagery and no official site photos exist (not on the Alberta Parks shop), so a view from their pads cannot be confirmed. Default-down: not waterfront, unless someone confirms the Lower Moose Landing sites see the lake.

POLICY CONTRADICTION: the operator's page gives a '$10 reservation fee' (provincial:AB row: C$12 via the Alberta Parks shop) and reservation by phone through Fox Creek Development, not the shop - written as reservation_fee 10 and platform 'phone' for this entry.
